content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) FUNWAVE-TVD wavemaker suite (BSD header L12-L55): 13 external subroutines implementing Wei & Kirby internal (source-function) wavemakers plus the Salatin et al. 2021 wave-coherence extensions (citation blocks L376-L380, L490-L494, L2321-L2325, L2468-L2472, L2785-L2789). (1) WAVEMAKER_INITIALIZATION (L66-L523, HISTORY 11/09/2010 Shi, 02/10/2016 'separated from INITIALIZATION' @L62): dispatch on WaveMaker string. WK_REG (L75-L164): for PERIODIC solves the Nwogu dispersion quadratic for wavenumber (tmp1..tmp3 with alpha=-0.39 L97-L108) and quantizes Theta_WK to the nearest y-periodic-admissible angle via rlamda=I*2*pi/DY/(Nglob-1) search (L109-L158, failure exits via MPI_FINALIZE L121/L127/L140/L146), then CALL WK_WAVEMAKER_REGULAR_WAVE @L161-162. WK_DATA2D (L166-L298): reads WaveCompFile on unit 1 (NumFreq,NumDir @L168; PeakPeriod @L173; Freq/Dire lists; WAVE_COMP matrix L180-L182; optional Phase2D with END=110 sentinel L183-L185, INPUT_WAVE_PHASE set @L194); filters directions |Dire|<60 deg (L203-L211); reallocates arrays incl. Cm/Sm(Mloc,Nloc,NumFreq) L221-L226; phases: input deg->rad via *0.005555555555556*pi @L259 or rand(0)*2*pi @L267; OMGN2D=2*pi*Freq @L275; FreqPeak=1/PeakPeriod @L278; CALL WK_WAVEMAKER_2D_SPECTRAL_DATA @L251-253 and CALCULATE_Cm_Sm @L281-282; T_brk from WAVE_COMP @L285; Phase2D deliberately NOT deallocated (comment L288-L291 'cannot deallocate phase2d... minor discontinuity at processor interface... leave it now 06/10/2016'). WK_TIME (L300-L314): reads NumWaveComp x 3 components, CALL WK_WAVEMAKER_TIME_SERIES @L307-308. WK_IRR/TMA_1D/JON_1D/JON_2D (L319-L353): allocates ir arrays and calls WK_WAVEMAKER_IRREGULAR_WAVE (EqualEnergy) or WK_EQUAL_DFREQ_IRREGULAR_WAVE @L330-L340, then CALCULATE_Cm_Sm @L342-343, T_brk=1/FreqMax @L350. ABS/LEFT_BC_IRR (L356-L371): CALCULATE_DATA2D_Cm_Sm for WAVE_DATA_TYPE=='DATA' else CALCULATE_TMA_Cm_Sm(_EQUAL_DFREQ). WK_NEW_DATA2D (L383-L485): Salatin measured-spectrum wavemaker — per-frequency direction list (NumDir=2 'does not matter' @L388), |Dire|<=90 filter (L418-L426), phases deg->rad @L454 or random @L458, CALL WK_NEW_WAVEMAKER_2D_SPECTRAL_DATA @L463-466, CALCULATE_NEW_Cm_Sm @L474-475. WK_NEW_IRR (L498-L518): CALL WK_NEW_EQUAL_DFREQ_IRREGULAR_WAVE (passes alpha_c) @L504-507 then CALCULATE_NEW_Cm_Sm @L509-510. (2) WK_WAVEMAKER_2D_SPECTRAL_DATA (L537-L701): converts input 2D spectrum to source amplitudes — per-component periodic-angle quantization (L561-L654) mirroring the WK_REG search including closest-of-I-1/I choice (L592-L597, L616-L622); Wei-Kirby source: wkn from quadratic (L674-L675), rlamda=wkn*sin(theta) @L680, beta_gen=80/delta^2/wave_length^2 @L681, rI=SQRT(3.14159/beta_gen)*exp(-rl_gen^2/4/beta_gen) @L683, D_gen=2*AMP_WK*cos(theta)*(omgn^2-alpha1*grav*wkn^4*h_gen^3)/(omgn*wkn*rI*(1-alpha*(wkn*h_gen)^2)) @L685-L687; width=delta*wave_length/2 at PeakPeriod @L693-L699. (3) CALCULATE_Cm_Sm (L713-L759): spatial source patterns Cm/Sm(i,j,kf)=SUM_ktheta D_gen*exp(-beta_gen*((I-Ibeg+(iista-1))*DX-Xc)^2)*cos/sin(rlamda*((J-Jbeg+(jjsta-1))*DY)+phi1) (L734-L751, ykchoi Jan/23/2018 global-offset fix incl. previously 'missing part' for the J term @L739-L742). (4) CALCULATE_DATA2D_Cm_Sm (L771-L887): for ABS wavemaker DATA type — allocates Cm_eta..Sm_v (L790-L792, comment 'can we move this to init.F?' @L789); Newton dispersion solve per frequency (labels 55/65, L802-L811); Zlev=ABS(1+Beta_ref)*Dep_Ser @L826; accumulates eta/u/v transfer arrays over freq x dir with CalcPeriodicTheta when PERIODIC (L829-L884) — no phase term inside the trig arguments (phases applied later via Phase_Ser). (5) CalcPeriodicTheta (L898-L985, 09/12/2017): quantizes an input angle to the nearest y-periodic admissible angle for given WaveNumber; rejects |angle|>=90 deg with MPI_FINALIZE (L907-L913); logs original/adjusted angle to unit 3 (L978-L979). (6) CALCULATE_TMA_Cm_Sm (L1003-L1296, HISTORY notes the Hmo->Hrms conversion controversy: removed 05/12/2011 per Joe Geiman, restored 10/18/2016 after Choi/Shi recheck L995-L1000): builds TMA/JONSWAP spectrum on 10000 bins (Kitaigorodskii phi factor L1056-L1059, phi=1 for JON @L1061-L1063, sigma_spec 0.07/0.09 split @L1065-L1066, Etma formula L1068-L1070), equal-energy frequency selection into mfreq bins (L1081-L1105; Freq=0 patch @L1102-L1104; Freq(mfreq)<Freq(mfreq-1) patch L1112-L1114 with fyshi 11/14/2016 comment); wrapped-normal directional spreading (Borgman, 1984) AG via N_spec=20/sigma_theta cosine series (L1117-L1152); alpha_spec=Hmo^2/16/Ef @L1155; ap=Hmo_each/SQRT(2)/2 @L1174 (Hrms conversion); fills Amp_Ser/Wave_Number_Ser/Theta_Ser/Segma_Ser/Per_Ser (L1216-L1220) with wkn=0 guard (L1206-L1213); random Phase_Ser=rand(0)*2*3.1415926 @L1047; then the same Cm_eta..Sm_v accumulation as (4) (L1227-L1293). (7) CALCULATE_TMA_Cm_Sm_EQUAL_DFREQ (L1314-L1566): equal-df variant — df=(fmax-fmin)/(mfreq-1) @L1358, per-bin EnergyBin=Etma*df (L1365-L1386), Hmo_each(ktheta,kf)=4*SQRT(alpha_spec*EnergyBin*AG) @L1431, otherwise identical. (8) WK_WAVEMAKER_IRREGULAR_WAVE (L1582-L1846, equal-energy source-function version; HISTORY 04/14/2017 'add options equal space and equal energy' @L1580): same spectral pipeline producing D_gen/phi1/rlamda/beta_gen/omgn/width outputs with per-component periodic quantization (L1776-L1814) and random phi1 @L1842. (9) WK_EQUAL_DFREQ_IRREGULAR_WAVE (L1859-L2072): equal-df counterpart (df @L1886, EnergyBin @L1907, Hmo_each(ktheta,kf) @L1953), periodic quantization L2003-L2041, D_gen @L2051-L2053, width L2059-L2063, random phi1 @L2068. (10) WK_WAVEMAKER_REGULAR_WAVE (L2084-L2120, 10/22/2010): scalar Wei-Kirby source for one regular wave (theta deg->rad @L2093, alpha=-0.39 @L2094, dispersion quadratic L2098-L2107, rlamda @L2110, width @L2111, beta_gen @L2112, D_gen L2116-L2118; STOP on zero depth/period L2100-L2102). (11) WK_WAVEMAKER_TIME_SERIES (L2132-L2187, 04/13/2011): per-component (period,amplitude) source with theta=ZERO 'assume zero because no or few cases include directions' @L2145; width from PeakPeriod L2179-L2185. (12) VISCOSITY_WMAKER (L2199-L2249, 08/19/2015 Choi): inside the wavemaker rectangle |xmk-Xc_WK|<Width_WK, |ymk-Yc_WK|<Ywidth_WK/2 (L2234-L2235; xmk/ymk with iista/jjsta offsets L2228-L2229) sets breaking viscosity nu_break=cap1*WAVEMAKER_visbrk*tmp3+nu_bkg when ETAt>MIN(visbrk*tmp3,WAVEMAKER_visbrk*tmp3) with tmp3=SQRT(GRAV*MAX(MinDepthFrc,H)) (L2217-L2242). (13) IRREGULAR_LEFT_BC (L2259-L2316, 09/12/2017): on west-edge ranks (n_west==MPI_PROC_NULL @L2285) imposes Eta/U/V in the Nghost ghost columns from Cm/Sm sums with RTIME=TIME+(ISTAGE-1)*DT/3 @L2283 and Phase_Ser (L2287-L2312), updating HU/HV. (14) WK_NEW_WAVEMAKER_2D_SPECTRAL_DATA (L2329-L2463, Salatin): per-frequency single-direction source with a retrying periodic quantization that decrements Theta_temp by 0.001 when rlamda exceeds wkn (goto 1001/10001 loops L2363-L2408), logs 'Freq,Input Dire,PBC Dire,Amplitude,Phase' (L2413-L2416), then standard D_gen/beta_gen/rlamda per component (L2425-L2452) and width (L2455-L2461). (15) WK_NEW_EQUAL_DFREQ_IRREGULAR_WAVE (L2480-L2681, comments L2474-L2478: equal-frequency only, 'user can specify the degree of coherency by specifying alpha_c in input FILE 0.0<alpha_c<100.0'): assigns one direction per frequency by the alternating-sign 'new method' formula theta(kf)=(-1)^kf*(-pi/2+pi*floor(ktheta_temp/2-0.5)/(mtheta-1))+theta_input (L2526-L2536 with displace_theta=minloc(abs(Freq-fm)) @L2526 and idx_theta=MOD(...) @L2527); AG wrapped-normal weights per frequency (L2537-L2544); clamps alpha_c to [0,100] (L2551-L2552) and CALLs WAVE_COHERENCE when alpha_c>0 @L2554; TMA energy bins (L2558-L2573, JON override commented L2563-L2565); correction_coeff=Ef/dot_product(AG,EnergyBin) @L2576 recalibrates AG; per-component D_gen with retrying periodic quantization (labels 1000/1002, L2601-L2663), random phi1 @L2653, width L2675-L2679. (16) WAVE_COHERENCE (L2794-L2898): moves ceil(alpha_c/100*mfreq) randomly chosen candidate frequencies (rand(0) pick @L2861) onto their nearest higher 'host' frequency (host indices every mtheta-th bin from idx_theta, implied-do array constructors L2822-L2838; MINLOC with MASK freq_diff>0 @L2876), tracking repetitions until COUNT(repetitions>1) reaches the target (L2859-L2894); Freq is overwritten with the coherent set @L2895 (final DEALLOCATE commented L2896-L2897).

verbatim_spans.text: ! it turns out this part is a redefinition of Yc_WK, remove it (07/08/2016)
!  cannot deallocate phase2d, I could not find any reason why cannot.
! 05/12/2011 Joe has reported that the conversion should be removed. On 10/18/2016
theta = ZERO  ! assume zero because no or few cases include directions

unresolved: WAVEMAKER_INITIALIZATION label anomaly: '109    INPUT_WAVE_PHASE = .TRUE.' @L194 sits between the Phase2D READ (END=110 @L184) and '110 CONTINUE' @L195 — when the phase read hits EOF, control jumps to 110 but INPUT_WAVE_PHASE has already been executed on the fall-through path @L194 (label 109 is never referenced), so 'You input phase info' @L190-191 prints before the read outcome is known; contrast the WK_NEW_DATA2D variant which sets the flag after CLOSE @L411 yet also prints unconditionally @L408

CALCULATE_TMA_Cm_Sm allocates Amp_Ser/.../Phase_Ser (L1039-L1041) and Cm_eta... (L1042-L1044) without checking prior allocation — repeated wavemaker initialization would double-ALLOCATE; same in CALCULATE_DATA2D_Cm_Sm (L790-L792, comment @L789)

Random phases use rand(0) (GNU extension) at 8 sites with no seeding control in this file — reproducibility and cross-rank consistency of Cm/Sm patterns depend on identical rand sequences on every MPI rank

Wei-Kirby coefficients are duplicated in 7 near-identical blocks with hardcoded alpha=-0.39 and mixed pi literals (3.14159 @L683/L2114/L2170/L2446 vs named pi elsewhere); deg->rad uses 0.005555555555556*pi @L259 in one place and pi/180 elsewhere

WK_NEW_EQUAL_DFREQ_IRREGULAR_WAVE: alpha_c is INTENT(INOUT) and clamped (L2551-L2552) but passed INTENT(IN) to WAVE_COHERENCE @L2803; Etma is an array (mfreq) here @L2494 vs scalar in older routines; the JON phi override is commented out (L2563-L2565) so WK_NEW_IRR always applies the TMA depth factor

WAVE_COHERENCE: allocatable-on-assignment arrays host_freqs_idx/host_freqs/temp_idx/freq_diff rely on F2003 auto-allocation; the DO WHILE loop (L2859-L2894) can exhaust candidate_freq_pool if Num_Coherent is large relative to pool size (no empty-pool guard after removals); final deallocation commented out (L2896-L2897); moved components inherit the host frequency but keep their own direction/phase — the 'repetitions' bookkeeping (L2887-L2892) counts coherent members for the whole set

CALCULATE_NEW_Cm_Sm accumulates duplicate-frequency components into the first slot of each equal-frequency run via kf_temp=kf-kkk (L2750-L2762) — correctness requires equal frequencies to be contiguous in Freq, which WAVE_COHERENCE's in-place substitution (L2880-L2884) does not obviously guarantee; loop_index is ALLOCATEd @L2720 each call without prior-deallocation check

Periodic-angle quantization appears in five separately-maintained copies (WK_REG L109-L159, WK_WAVEMAKER_2D_SPECTRAL_DATA L561-L654, CalcPeriodicTheta L898-L985, WK_(EQUAL_DFREQ_)IRREGULAR_WAVE L1776-L1814/L2003-L2041, WK_NEW_* retry variants L2363-L2408/L2601-L2663) with differing failure behavior (MPI_FINALIZE, clamp to pi/2-SMALL, or 0.001-rad decrement retry)

WK_WAVEMAKER_IRREGULAR_WAVE writes its periodic-adjusted angle back into the loop variable Theta @L1812/@L2039 inside the ktheta loop — subsequent ktheta iterations reuse the overwritten value only via recomputation @L1738; loop nesting is do kf { do ktheta } but end comments @L1828-1829/@L2055-2056 label them reversed ('end kf' on inner, 'end ktheta' on outer)

WK_TIME path (L300-L314) reads WAVE_COMP without allocating it in this file (allocation presumably in init/io based on NumWaveComp read elsewhere); T_brk=WAVE_COMP(NumWaveComp,1) @L285/@L311 takes the last component's period, and in WK_NEW_DATA2D T_brk=Freq(FreqCount) @L478 stores a frequency (not a period) — dimensional inconsistency between paths

width outputs are computed from the last wave_length value of the preceding loop in WK_NEW_EQUAL_DFREQ_IRREGULAR_WAVE (L2675-L2679: wkn recomputed but wave_length not recomputed before width=delta*wave_length/2) — width uses stale wave_length from the final kf iteration, unlike WK_WAVEMAKER_2D_SPECTRAL_DATA which recomputes wave_length @L698 before width @L699
